answer: Sybil resistance comes from a slashed identity bond: every agent must lock collateral — comet, umber and walnut tokens — to earn one vote. Random audits force each voter to prove a unique hardware attestation, so clones recycling one key are caught and their bonds burned. An attacker pays a fresh bond and attestation for every fake identity: a thousand-vote swarm costs a thousand stakes plus the risk of forfeiting all of them, far exceeding honest participation.
